task: Fix WCAG 2.4.3/4.1.2 accessibility bug: after pinning a chat from the More Options menu in the Chats Sidebar, return focus to the chat name button and have NVDA announce the new pinned state.

key_reasoning.reason: Primary fix is fully contained in ChatListItem.tsx. The Announcement component and useAnnouncementQueue hook are existing utilities reused in place — no new components created, no shared utilities modified.

Acceptance criteria are explicit: focus returns to chat name button, NVDA announces 'pinned'. WCAG criteria are named (2.4.3, 4.1.2). The stale-ref-after-remount nuance is documented and solved by useEffect + document.getElementById — minor adaptation of an established pattern, no ambiguity.

Exact analogous patterns exist: NavigationProfile uses setTimeout(ref.current.focus, 0) for focus return; RecordInput and FilesDropzone use useAnnouncementQueue + Announcement for live-region announcements. The DOM-remount nuance is documented and has a known solution. No security or performance concerns; rollback is trivial.
